submissions.title: First submission: six-block LoRA holdout contrastive + gold logistic heads
R0: frozen DINOv2-S + E5-base, LM MLP heads
submissions.outcome: E5-base > E5-small agrees with 58-case gold AUROC, not I->T R@1; but gold AUROC misorders E5-small (0.7541) vs first submission (0.7594 56-OOF, public 0.717). Head type (LM-MLP vs gold logistic) is the only factor consistent with all three public scores.

submissions.title: R0-style frozen DINOv2-S + E5-small, LM MLP heads
submissions.outcome: E5-base > E5-small agrees with 58-case gold AUROC, not I->T R@1; but gold AUROC misorders E5-small (0.7541) vs first submission (0.7594 56-OOF, public 0.717). Head type (LM-MLP vs gold logistic) is the only factor consistent with all three public scores.

submissions.title: R4a K8 multi-slice fine-tune (DINOv2-S, hard)
submissions.outcome: +0.038 over 0.788 (local LM-test +0.036): LM-test gain transferred almost 1:1.

submissions.title: R4a K8 OmniRad-base (hard)
submissions.outcome: +0.013 over R4a despite an LM-test tie (+0.0003); direction matches gold-58 (+0.030). One pair; single seed.

submissions.title: R4a K8 soft labels (DINOv2-S)
submissions.outcome: +0.008 over hard R4a (0.826) with an LM-test tie and gold +0.039. Inside the pre-registered inconclusive band (0.833-0.837): about half the gold-scaled prediction (+0.017), not the LM-test prediction (0). Single seed; public-split noise not estimated.

submissions.title: Run 5: OmniRad-base, soft, 336 px
submissions.outcome: +0.040 over OmniRad-base hard 224 (0.839) and +0.045 over soft R4a (0.834): new best public single model. Far above both predictions (LM-test +0.007, gold +0.013), so public moved much more than either local measure. Single seed; soft + 336 stacked, so not attributable.

submissions.title: u9-b1: run 5 with 9 image blocks unfrozen
submissions.outcome: +0.009 over run 5 (0.879): new best public single model. Close to the LM-test prediction (about 0.885); well short of what gold-58's +0.051 implied. Single seed, LM-test CI included zero, so not attributable beyond noise on local evidence alone.
